definitions.gloss: to simmer, to stew, to cook slowly
definitions.explanation: To cook food slowly in liquid over low heat for an extended time.

examples.japanese: {肉|にく}を{柔|やわ}らかくなるまで{煮込|にこ}む。
examples.english: To simmer the meat until tender.

examples.japanese: よく{煮込|にこ}んだスープ。

notes:
{煮込|にこ}む means to simmer or stew food slowly, allowing flavors to blend thoroughly.

COMPOUND VERB:
{煮|に}る (to boil/cook) + {込|こ}む (into, thoroughly) - the {込|こ}む adds the nuance of cooking deeply or for an extended time.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を particle: カレーを{煮込|にこ}む

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {弱火|よわび}で{煮込|にこ}む: to simmer over low heat
- じっくり{煮込|にこ}む: to simmer thoroughly
- {味|あじ}が{染|し}みるまで{煮込|にこ}む: to simmer until flavors soak in

COMMON DISHES:
- {煮込|にこ}みうどん: stewed udon
- {煮込|にこ}みハンバーグ: hamburger steak in sauce
- {牛|ぎゅう}{すじ|すじ}の{煮込|にこ}み: simmered beef tendon
